comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: Most tourists only see luxury overwater villas, but living in the Maldives on these remote local atolls is a masterclass in resilience. Dealing with fresh water shortages, relying on fishing boats for daily survival, and facing the constant threat of rising tides—yet the locals move with such quiet grace and dignity. Thank you for showing the real heart of this country beyond the resort brochures.
